name: Transpose: MACHINES + TRIG 15 / 16 move the TRIG keyboard an octave, MACHINES + TRIG 8 / 9 / 11 / 12 make the active track's pitch jump -7 / -5 / +5 / +7 semitones
description: A part of model27's builder, not a machine (the plan of 2026-11-05, _scratch/machines-transpose/plan.md): built once into transpose.o by tools/gen_parts.py, added by tools/compose.py to a build when its card is ticked (compose.py --transpose), with or without packages, always with the shortcut layer (since its 0.6 MACHINES is then a held key on every track; the composer sets the layer's flag and writes the layer's data block's address into this part's). In keyboard mode, MACHINES held, FUNC and TRACK not: KeyboardView's key handler (its vtable +8, 0x400ff9cc) goes to tr_keys, which takes TRIG 8, 9, 11, 12, 15 and 16 and their releases, marks the layer's +0x13 and asks for a new LED frame; the keyboard's read of KBT (0x4001a164) goes to tr_kbt, which adds 12 semitones per octave of the active track (two at most either way, KBT never written, clamped to -60..+60); the audio function's call of the smoother (0x400597a8) goes to tr_pitch, which adds the track's jump to the PITCH word of its output (0x100 a semitone, clamped to 0x2800..0x5800), so that the jump is at once, on the note that plays, and clears every value when the playing pattern changes; the LED frame's call of the views (0x40006a76) goes to tr_frame, which sets the six keys' states before every view (dim 0x102, mid 0x202, full 2) and their bits in two masks per latch row; since 0.2 the panel interrupt's LED step 0 (0x40059dea) goes to tr_led, which loads the rows with a masked LED out of their turn, a dim LED lit 1 cycle of n, a mid one 2 of n (n from the data block, 4 by default: 1/4 and 1/2 at 250 Hz), each write 2 us apart by PIT3's counter, notes/45 §6's principle written anew. Everything else goes to the stock code unchanged. The values live in the data block, per track, in RAM only.

gestures.meaning: the active track's pitch jumps -7 / -5 / +5 / +7 semitones from its PITCH; the jump in force again: back
gestures.replaces: plays the note on the TRIG keyboard, as without MACHINES

gestures.meaning: the TRIG keyboard an octave down / up, two at most, on top of KBT
gestures.replaces: plays the note on the TRIG keyboard, as without MACHINES
